verdicts.evidence:
You are invited to our son Chris's 5th birthday.

We celebrate on 7th August, next Friday, around noon at our home in Lackers Street 5, and wrap up around dinner time, around 7 pm.

There will be plenty of snacks and food, including birthday cake and salty snacks, so there is no need to bring anything with you. Just bring yourself and some joy.

Chris says he wants a dinosaur park and recently started collecting dinosaurs for his personal dinosaur park. If you would like to give him something special, please choose your favorite dinosaur at Carl's toy store around the corner.

Best wishes,
Susanne and Mike
Chris' parents
verdicts.rationale: The signed invitation invites recipients to the fifth birthday of Susanne and Mike's son, Chris.
